ext.description: View AI-analyzed code (.scope/analysis.jsonl) as a tree, call graph, hovers and CodeLens — refresh structure with language servers and summarize changed functions with your signed-in AI agent.
cmd.refresh: Scope: Refresh (reload records and structure, no LLM)
cmd.openExplorerHere: Scope: Open Explorer at This Function
cfg.jsonlPath: Path of the analysis records JSONL (relative to the workspace)
cfg.callTreeMaxDepth: Maximum depth for expanding call/caller chains in the tree
cfg.graphDepth: Default callee depth for the call graph and Mermaid (1-4, changeable in the explorer)
cfg.graphOpenIn: Where the explorer opens the first time
cfg.graphOpenIn.window: In a separate VS Code window
cfg.graphOpenIn.beside: As a tab in the editor group beside
cfg.graphOpenIn.active: As a tab in the current editor group
cfg.analyzer: Engine that writes summaries. Function bodies are sent to it. Use 'Scope: Choose Analysis Engine' to detect signed-in agents and pick a model.
cfg.analyzer.claude: Claude Code CLI (claude -p) — uses your signed-in CLI, no key stored
cfg.analyzer.vscodelm: VS Code language models (GitHub Copilot etc.)
cfg.analyzer.ollama: Ollama on this machine — code stays local
cfg.claudePath: Path of the claude CLI (when it is not on PATH)
cfg.analyzeModel: Model for summaries, in the selected engine's format (e.g. sonnet / haiku for Claude Code, provider/model for OpenCode). Empty = the engine's default
cfg.autoAnalyze: When to write summaries automatically — uses your AI agent
cfg.autoAnalyze.onClick: When you click a changed or new function in the tree or graph
cfg.autoAnalyze.onSave: On click, and on save for changed or new functions in that file
cfg.autoAnalyzeMaxPerHour: Maximum functions auto-analysis summarizes per hour (manual analysis is unlimited)
cfg.scanOnSave: On save, reload that file's structure (moved, new, deleted functions) — no LLM
cfg.scanOnStartup: Refresh structure a few seconds after startup — no LLM
cfg.gitIntegration: Include git-changed files in refresh, and refresh after branch switch, pull or commit
cfg.openExplorerOnStartup: Open the explorer when the workspace opens
cfg.scanInclude: Where refresh looks for new source files (glob, relative to the workspace folder). Empty = the top-level folders of already analyzed files (e.g. src/**)
cfg.scanExclude: Paths to skip when looking for new source files (glob)
cfg.summaryLanguage.ask: Not set — ask before the first analysis and save to this workspace
